description: A dietary supplement product contains a discrete ingredient represented by a Food entity.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last created or updated.

common_properties.name: quantity
common_properties.description: Amount of each contributing ingredient in the supplement product.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor; quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned.

common_properties.name: unit
common_properties.description: Raw NHANES DSDUNIT code for each contributing ingredient’s amount unit; no label table is provided.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor; quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned.

common_properties.name: operator
common_properties.description: Amount comparison operator (=, <, or >) for each contributing ingredient.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor; quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: Ingredient category: Vitamin, Mineral, Botanical, Other, or Amino acid. When contributing ingredients differ in category, the value is Other.

source_contributions.scope: Discrete food ingredients in dietary supplement products reported by NHANES participants, from the Dietary Supplement Database Ingredient Information (DSII). Coverage includes ingredients mapped to existing Food entities; unresolved ingredients have no relationship.
source_contributions.description: Food ingredients are identified through a curated food map or a frozen, human-reviewed ingredient mapping. Different ingredients in one product can refer to the same Food entity; their quantities, units, and operators remain separate aligned list elements. In the single-ingredient case each list has length 1.
